name: Max's at Red Hill Estate
address: 53 Shoreham Rd, Red Hill South VIC 3937
signature: A Red Hill institution with panoramic vineyard views over Western Port, permanently closed February 2026, the estate winery continues.
editorNote:
Max's at Red Hill Estate closed in February 2026. For twenty-plus years it was one of the Peninsula's most reliable cellar-door dining experiences: the dining room perched at the top of the estate slope with a sweep of vineyard dropping away toward Western Port and French Island in the middle distance, the Chardonnay and Pinot Noir poured from the estate below, and a kitchen that understood what the room was asking it to do.

It was not the most adventurous kitchen on the Peninsula. It did not need to be. The combination of a genuinely spectacular view, a well-made estate wine list, and a long lunch format that did not demand you justify the drive, that was the proposition, and it worked. The closure removes the best view-plus-wine-plus-lunch package in the Red Hill hinterland from an already thin field.

The Red Hill Estate winery and cellar door continue to operate. The sparkling program, particularly the Blanc de Blancs and the rosé, remains one of the Peninsula's most consistent, and the cellar door tasting room retains the panoramic position. It is not the same as lunch, but it is not nothing.
whyWeGo: Max's is the Peninsula long lunch that shaped the category for decades, the closure matters precisely because the room set the standard that others are still working toward.
ifOnlyOneThing: Visit the cellar door while the estate winery continues to operate, the sparkling program is among the Peninsula's best, and the view from the tasting room is unchanged.
